title: Pay the widths incurred while acquiring a compressed nonlinear representation
statement: The native final reports a direct ordinary Boolean-DAG to binary matrix branching-program route, processing shared gates once and deleting output-irrelevant states. Finite-difference relations are acquired without monomial/assignment enumeration. One width3 example has16777217 reduced ANF terms. Polynomial cost is in actual intermediate widths in the chosen order, not final size; sparse cubic counting is still contained before the additional certificate.

requires: Actual source evaluations and successfully acquired nonlinear-completion/geometric certificate
For the gate route: supplied ordinary Boolean DAG, chosen variable order and paid ACTUAL intermediate matrix-program widths
Conditions expressed in acquired completion coordinates; new original-input conditions need separate admission
provides: A source-reported ANF-expansion-avoiding discovery route with an explicit intermediate representation budget
assumptions: The final-zero circuit can exceed width earlier
Small final representation or unknown favorable order does not supply cheap acquisition
The same-task exclusive-input comparator wins the recorded full cycle; no practical superiority
costs: Source acquisition, shared gate processing/minimization, successive linear solves/evaluations, all intermediate widths and original reconstruction checks
Count, witness, rank/unrank and exact uniform original samples are separate paid outputs; favorable final width alone is insufficient
contract.units: Exact intermediate matrix widths/circuit sizes, ANF term counts and paid original-output work; no general counting complexity collapse.
contract.obstruction: A compressed endpoint is not an acquisition algorithm or a counting certificate.

evidence.quote: **I changed the target from recovering a smaller linear state to discovering a reversible information decomposition of a nonlinear computation.** The completed construction acquires both the observable information and the minimum additional information needed to reconstruct every original input. I then extended its acquisition path so that it can operate directly on ordinary Boolean gate DAGs without expanding their ANFs.
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: Only the complete native final response and its original rendered/activity transport were acquired. The named proof, executable and independent review originals remain unacquired under the existing no-export restriction. Completed independent reviews are producer-reported at their described scopes; no acquired-review overlay or source replay is manufactured. This is a restricted constructive conditional-inference class, not general polynomial circuit counting. The matched same-original-task exclusive-input elimination was cheaper. A separate odd-dimensional field-cube family has two originals per output but no one-bit affine discriminator; one quadratic bit works. Information length and algebraic complexity differ. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
